title: US stocks: Retail buyers limit Nvidia stock rout
summary: Retail investors poured a record $111 million into Nvidia shares during Thursday’s first half-hour of trading, helping the stock trim an opening loss of as much as 14% to about 5%. The dip-buying suggests confidence in the AI trade remains resilient despite CEO Jensen Huang’s departure and Nvidia’s loss of more than $1 trillion in market value over five weeks.

title: US Fed sets new meeting schedule for 2027, as foretold by Chairman Kevin Warsh
summary: The Federal Reserve will hold seven rate-setting meetings in 2027 instead of the customary eight, while dedicating its October gathering to broader monetary-policy strategy. The revised schedule also moves the year’s final policy meeting to November and removes designations for quarterly economic projections as Chair Kevin Warsh reviews the Fed’s communication practices.
